name: Sophie Langley
source:
Although she only made her way to New York City at the turn of the century, Sophie Langley has been around for a long time. 

As she settled into her second century of undeath, her taste for art and the sublime shifted to wanting more recognition and influence. 

Although she is still an almost stereotypical [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Toreador_(VTM)]Toreador[/url] at heart, that's exactly how she wants others to perceive her - as a harmless, self-centered diva with no political ambitions. The truth, however, is much different...

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
